definitions.explanation: Refers back to something that was mentioned or described earlier in a text or document.

examples.japanese: {前記|ぜんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同意|どうい}する→同意する：06056_douisuru⟧。
examples.english: I agree to the aforementioned conditions.

examples.japanese: {前記|ぜんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧、⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{末|まつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧です。
examples.english: As stated above, the application deadline is the end of next month.

examples.japanese: {前記|ぜんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誤|あやま}り→誤り：01772_ayamari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{速|すみ}やか→速やか：15283_sumiyaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If there are any errors in the above content, please contact us promptly.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (before, previous) + {記|き} (record, write). A formal written term used in documents, contracts, articles, and official correspondence to refer back to something previously written.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前記|ぜんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ — as stated above
- {前記|ぜんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ — the aforementioned conditions
- {前記|ぜんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧ — the above content
- {前記|ぜんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧ — the aforementioned matters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上記|じょうき}→上記：11375_jouki⟧ — above-mentioned (very similar; more commonly used in modern documents)
- ⟦{上述|じょうじゅつ}→上述：22219_joujutsu⟧ — aforementioned (more formal/academic)
- ⟦{下記|かき}→下記：11376_kaki⟧ — below-mentioned (the opposite: referring to what follows)
- {後述|こうじゅつ} — described later (formal; refers to what will be mentioned later)

REGISTER:
Strictly a written, formal term. Not used in conversation. In casual writing, ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or ⟦さっき→さっき：01264_sakki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ would be used instead.
